title: [2.8.2 newest DEV] wear bolusing not possible
body:
Since using the newest DEV version creating a bolus from the attached wear os watch isn't possible any more.

Switching back to the previous one and now the bolus support on the watch is active again

comments.body: I tested the issue in the latest DEV version. Problem isn't solved. If you want to bolus with a Wear OS smartwatch (Sony SWR50) it isn't possible anymore. Previous versions work fine.
